events.name: ACTION
events.description: Declarative event name — emits UI:{action} via eventBus on click

events.name: HOVER
events.description: Declarative hover event — emits UI:{hoverEvent} with { hovered: true/false } on mouseEnter/mouseLeave

overridableConfigKeys.label: Action
overridableConfigKeys.description: Declarative event name — emits UI:{action} via eventBus on click

overridableConfigKeys.label: Action Payload
overridableConfigKeys.description: Payload to include with the action event

overridableConfigKeys.label: Animate Changes
overridableConfigKeys.description: Content that appears or changes inside the box eases in instead of switching in one frame (new rows, swapped views, changed text), played in presentation motion (the theme's dramatic duration, standard easing) so it can be watched. Off under reduced motion.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-busy
overridableConfigKeys.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-current
overridableConfigKeys.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-describedby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-expanded
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-hidden
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-labelledby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-live
overridableConfigKeys.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-pressed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Toggle-button state.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-selected
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Backdrop
overridableConfigKeys.description: Scene behind the band's content (photo, illustration, pattern); never takes clicks

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bg
overridableConfigKeys.description: Background color

overridableConfigKeys.label: Border
overridableConfigKeys.description: Show border

overridableConfigKeys.label: Children
overridableConfigKeys.description: Children elements

overridableConfigKeys.label: Class Name
overridableConfigKeys.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the root element.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dir
overridableConfigKeys.description: Text direction of this element's content.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Display
overridableConfigKeys.description: Display type

overridableConfigKeys.label: Edge Bottom
overridableConfigKeys.description: Shape cut into the bottom edge of a full-width band; 'curve' uses the theme's shape

overridableConfigKeys.label: Edge Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Surface of the neighbouring band, which fills the cut

overridableConfigKeys.label: Edge Flip
overridableConfigKeys.description: Mirror the edge shapes horizontally

overridableConfigKeys.label: Edge Top
overridableConfigKeys.description: Shape cut into the top edge of a full-width band; 'curve' uses the theme's shape

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter
overridableConfigKeys.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter Delay
overridableConfigKeys.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Full Height
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fill available height

overridableConfigKeys.label: Full Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fill available width

overridableConfigKeys.label: Hover Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Declarative hover event — emits UI:{hoverEvent} with { hovered: true/false } on mouseEnter/mouseLeave

overridableConfigKeys.label: Lang
overridableConfigKeys.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Margin
overridableConfigKeys.description: Margin on all sides

overridableConfigKeys.label: Margin X
overridableConfigKeys.description: Horizontal margin

overridableConfigKeys.label: Margin Y
overridableConfigKeys.description: Vertical margin

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maximum width (CSS value, e.g., '550px', '80rem')

overridableConfigKeys.label: Overflow
overridableConfigKeys.description: Overflow behavior

overridableConfigKeys.label: Padding
overridableConfigKeys.description: Padding on all sides

overridableConfigKeys.label: Padding X
overridableConfigKeys.description: Horizontal padding (overrides padding for x-axis)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Padding Y
overridableConfigKeys.description: Vertical padding (overrides padding for y-axis)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Position
overridableConfigKeys.description: Position

overridableConfigKeys.label: Role
overridableConfigKeys.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Rounded
overridableConfigKeys.description: Border radius

overridableConfigKeys.label: Shadow
overridableConfigKeys.description: Box shadow

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skeleton
overridableConfigKeys.description: Skeleton shown while this element's server render is in flight: a shape (`table`, `list`, …), `{ variant, rows?, columns?, fields? }`, or `none`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tab Index
overridableConfigKeys.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tap Reveal
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true (default), a touch/pen tap also fires `hoverEvent` (toggling hovered) so hover-only reveals work on touch.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Texture
overridableConfigKeys.description: Lay the theme's texture over the band
